title: 正在 / 在 + verb: doing right now
summary: Lets you say an action is happening right now, as in 他正在看书.
structure: Subject + 正在 + Verb (+ Object) (+ 呢)
Subject + 在 + Verb (+ Object) (+ 呢)
explanation:
To say something is in progress ('is doing'), put 正在 or just 在 before the verb: 他正在看书 'He is reading.' 正在 stresses 'right at this moment'; 在 is more everyday. 呢 at the end adds the same feeling and is common in speech: 他在睡觉呢.

Chinese verbs don't change form, so this is how you show 'is …ing'. To answer 'What are you doing?' (你在做什么？), use the same pattern.

examples.en: I'm on the phone right now.

mistakes.why: 正在 goes before the verb, not after it.
Don't add 是: 在 + verb is enough for 'am eating'.

why: Correct: 正在 + verb means 'is doing right now'.
是 doesn't show an action in progress.
了 belongs after the verb and means it's done.

exercises.prompt: Which answers '你在做什么？' (What are you doing?)
why: Correct: 在 + verb says what you're doing now.

exercises.instruction: Say it is happening right now (use 正在).
why: Correct: put 正在 before the verb.
正在 can't go at the end.
正在 can't go inside 上课; it goes before the whole verb.

exercises.why: Subject + 正在 + verb, and 呢 can close the sentence.

why: Correct: 呢 at the end goes with 在 + verb for 'right now'.
吗 would make it a question.
吧 would make it a suggestion or a guess.
